source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Mask fit carrying fairly little established relationship to how effective this particular treatment ends up being for the client's overall care","B":"Essentially any mask size being considered appropriate, without much regard for the client's own individual facial structure or shape","C":"This particular assessment being needed just a single time, at the very first moment the mask is applied to the client's face at the start of treatment","D":"A poorly fitting mask can cause air leaks (reducing treatment effectiveness) or skin breakdown from excessive pressure, both important safety and efficacy considerations"}}
source_row.rationale: Proper NIV mask fit is important because a poorly fitting mask can cause air leaks (reducing treatment effectiveness) or skin breakdown from excessive pressure at contact points, requiring ongoing reassessment throughout use, not just at initial application, to maintain both safety and efficacy.
source_row.source_detail: Importance of Proper and Ongoing Mask Fit Assessment
